units.statement: Let E be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space with its Borel structure, including rank zero. Let V be globally C2 and 0<alpha<=beta with alpha||a||²<=D²V(x)[a,a]<=beta||a||² for every x,a. For eta>0 and beta*eta<=1, let mu be the literal normalized volume tilt exp(-V), J the actual law of (X,X+sqrt(eta)G) with independent X~mu and standard Gaussian G, and nu=J.snd. The theorem produces genuine probability of mu,J,nu and common Markov kernels R,S, with R disintegrating swappedJ, every-y S the pushforward of R by x->2x-y and the exact normalized density exp(-V((y+u)/2)-||y-u||²/(8eta)). For every signed globally smooth compactly supported f, Tf(y)=integral f dS(y) is globally differentiable, f,Tf and its true gradient belong to L2(nu), and the actual conditional variance is integrable under nu. Its outer integral equals integral f²dnu-integral(Tf)²dnu. Moreover eta integral||gradientTf||²dnu is at most (1-alphaeta)²/[4(1+alphaeta)] times that same defect. All probability, conditional-law and analytic domains are outputs; no centering of f or extra certificates are assumed.

steps.title: Produce genuine laws and one common conditional kernel
steps.text: The genuine Hessian/Gibbs parent gives a strictly positive normalizer and probability of the literal Gaussian augmentation. A nonintegrable exponential has totalized integral zero, contradicting that normalizer; therefore mu is genuinely normalized. Its joint second marginal nu is a probability. Reuse the already verified pointwise parent to obtain one R/S before all observations, including its every-y normalized reflected density.

steps.title: Retain all actual finite second-moment domains
steps.text: Compact continuity bounds |f| by a finite M. Every S_y and nu is an actual probability, so f lies in all required L2 spaces. Measurable kernel integration makes Tf and the conditional second moment strongly measurable; their bounds M and M² produce Tf L2 and conditional-second-moment L1 under nu. No analytic-domain certificate is supplied by the caller.
steps.formula: |f|\le M,\quad|Tf(y)|\le M,\quad f\in L^2(\nu)\cap L^2(S_y),\quad Tf\in L^2(\nu).
steps.lean: MemLp.of_bound; StronglyMeasurable.integral_kernel; norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const; hfy2; hTf2; hfsqI

steps.title: Integrate through the same disintegration
steps.text: The actual conditional predicate gives nu compProd R=swappedJ. Push f² through the explicit reflected map in each fiber, then use Fubini with the bounded measurable joint integrand. This uses the very same R/S returned by the pointwise parent and does not identify unrelated conditional witnesses pointwise.

steps.title: Use actual Gaussian reflection invariance
steps.text: The genuine Gaussian parent fixes X and reflects the auxiliary Y about X; this joint pushforward preserves J. Applying the second-coordinate projection gives that the reflected second moment equals the original nu second moment. This is invariance of the augmentation law, not invariance or nonexplosion of a PBPS process.

steps.title: Produce the exact conditional variance defect
steps.text: On each actual probability fiber, its genuine L2 domain allows the centered-square variance identity. Integrability of both outer terms gives integrability of the actual variance and allows subtraction under the integral. Joint reflection identifies the first term, so the displayed defect is exact even for noncentered signed f.
steps.lean: Poincare.variance; variance_eq_integral; variance_eq_sub; Integrable.congr; integral_sub; hvdef

steps.title: Derive the true outer gradient domain
steps.text: The pointwise parent proves actual differentiability of Tf. Mathlib measurable_fderiv followed by the continuous inverse Riesz map makes its true gradient strongly measurable. Its square is dominated by C_eta times the already integrable actual conditional variance, so it is integrable and the gradient lies in L2(nu). Fiber Poincare domains are not substituted for this outer domain.
steps.lean: measurable_fderiv; toDual.symm.continuous; Integrable.mono_nonneg; memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm; hgradI; hgrad2

steps.title: Integrate with the exact source coefficient
steps.text: All domains have now been produced. Integrate the pointwise inequality, multiply by positive eta, and simplify the genuine positive denominators. Substitute the exact variance-defect identity. The coefficient remains sharp, including its zero at alphaeta=1; no arbitrary energy premise is introduced.

steps.title: Consume the Gaussian precision and zero-dimensional boundaries
steps.text: For the actual quadratic potential V=||x||²/2 with alpha=beta=eta=1, the coefficient is zero. The actual gradient energy therefore vanishes, while global differentiability, all three L2 domains, variance L1 and its defect identity remain available. A separate fully stated Test specializes these actual laws and domains to rank zero.
